legacy_client_gate_script: metraiyux_0s_site/Free99/free99-gate.js is legacy-only and must not be injected into newly mounted apps
rule: SkyeOpsConsole, Still2Vid Forge, MyDrive Offline Vault, SkyePics, BrandForge core, Social Batch Factory core, and KeyGate 13 are Free99/no-charge apps. Free still requires FS27/0S gate ownership so every user signs in before using the app. Free99 never includes free AI/model calls, provider-backed generation, hosted custody, outbound provider actions, or white-label tenant/resale use. JobPing is mounted under the gate with its own SkyPay-priced lane.

apps.name: Sign In Pro by NorthStar
apps.summary: Business-facing Sign In Pro demo lane. Demo users enter a rotating two-day code plus signup details, receive a demo-only shared 0S gate session, and remain tracked without owner/admin scope.

apps.name: SkyeOpsConsole v2.13
apps.summary: Offline operations console. No-charge lane, still gate-session owned.

apps.name: Still2Vid Forge v4
apps.summary: Browser-local image-to-video forge for real uploaded, live-surface, open-source, or AI-receipted images and logos. Fake initials/text-logo source is blocked before export.

apps.name: MyDrive Offline Encrypted Vault
apps.summary: Local encrypted file vault. No-charge lane, still gate-session owned and platform-metered.

apps.name: SkyePics Vault
apps.summary: Local encrypted camera/photo vault with client-side OCR and secret detection. Gate-owned even when local-first.

apps.name: BrandForge Campaign Studio
apps.price: Free99 core; SkyPay paid AI generation tiers
apps.summary: Offline campaign studio with local intelligence scoring, SkyPay checkout/claim, and paid provider-backed AI generation after entitlement.

apps.name: Social Batch Factory
apps.price: Free99 core; SkyPay paid AI copy tiers with caps
apps.summary: Browser-local campaign asset batch generator. Free99 core exports stay local; paid AI copy generation requires a confirmed FS27/SkyGate entitlement and monthly cap.

apps.name: KeyGate 13
apps.summary: Browser-local credential suite with Key Forge, Variable Vault, HKDF Key Derive, and Pass Lab. No backend custody, provider calls, hosted recovery, or app-specific admin password.

apps.name: JobPing

apps.name: SkyeAPI + AegisCore

apps.summary: Credential, capability, provider, and gateway control plane. Paid platform lane.

apps.summary: Document workflow platform with export quotas, template library, partner review, and paid plans.

apps.name: Doctor Ops Personal Vault

apps.summary: Local-first personal doctor workflow vault. Not an EHR or regulated medical advice product.

apps.name: Documorph

apps.name: SkyeArcade Sovereign Vault

apps.name: kAIxU Storefront
apps.summary: Mini storefront and product-ecology source for future approved offers.

paid_entitlement_required_for: provider-backed generation, embedding, transcription, image, video, or campaign copy work
hosted backup, recovery, profile sync, or durable custody beyond local browser storage
external publishing, social posting, email/SMS, route provider, payment, identity, or compliance-provider actions
white-label resale, tenant provisioning, custom branded portals, and selling access to the 0S as a customer-owned platform
